Playbook.name: PAN-OS — Firewall Configuration Change by an Unexpected Administrator - SOC Playbook

ExecutiveSummary.Overview: A PAN-OS configuration change was made by an administrator first-seen via new_terms - an admin who does not normally change this firewall. Triage question: is this a legitimate admin acting under change control, or an unexpected/compromised admin modifying the firewall?
ExecutiveSummary.BusinessImpact: Firewall config changes by an unexpected admin can open exposure or disable protection; new_terms flags the unfamiliar actor specifically.

Assets.AssetType: Internal and DMZ hosts behind PAN-OS

TelemetryRequirements.Requirement: PAN-OS logs via Elastic Agent to logs-panw.panos-* (verified live).

Fields: panw.panos.sub_type (vulnerability/spyware/CONFIG/...), panw.panos.action (alert/allow/reset-both/drop), event.severity (numeric; lower = more severe, 5 = informational), panw.panos.threat_category, panw.panos.threat.name, panw.panos.admin, panw.panos.cmd, panw.panos.path, panw.panos.result, source.ip, destination.ip, destination.port, network.application.

Signal.Name: Unexpected admin config change
Signal.Details: panw.panos.type CONFIG by a first-seen admin.

InitialAssessment.Rule: A newly-onboarded but legitimate admin will fire new_terms once; the concern is an unfamiliar admin making sensitive changes with no change record.

Investigation.Goal: Determine whether the unexpected admin is a legitimate (perhaps new) administrator under change control or an unauthorised/compromised actor.

Step.name: What did this admin change
Step.Purpose: The commands and paths reveal whether sensitive objects (security rules, admins, NAT) were changed vs benign settings.
Step.Query: FROM logs-panw.panos-* | WHERE panw.panos.type == "CONFIG" AND panw.panos.admin == "$admin" AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 4 hours | STATS changes = COUNT(*), cmds = VALUES(panw.panos.cmd), paths = VALUES(panw.panos.path), results = VALUES(panw.panos.result), first_seen = MIN(@timestamp), last_seen = MAX(@timestamp) | LIMIT 1
Step.AnalystNotes: paths containing rulebase/security/rules, address, nat, or mgt-config/admin are sensitive. A burst of set/delete commands in minutes is a significant change session. result 'Succeeded' means it applied.

Step.name: Did this admin log in from an unusual source
Step.Purpose: Correlate with the admin's authentication to confirm the session origin is expected.
Step.Query: FROM logs-panw.panos-* | WHERE panw.panos.admin == "$admin" AND panw.panos.sub_type IN ("auth","general") AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 4 hours | KEEP @timestamp, panw.panos.admin, source.ip, panw.panos.client_type, panw.panos.result | SORT @timestamp DESC | LIMIT 15
Step.AnalystNotes: An admin authenticating from an unusual source (public IP, unexpected client_type) before the change is a red flag.

Node.Condition: INV-01 shows sensitive changes (security rules, NAT, admin objects) by an unfamiliar admin with no change record.
Node.Result: True Positive (Unauthorised Firewall Change - escalate, review and revert)

Node.Condition: INV-02 shows the admin authenticated from an unusual/public source before the change.
INV-01/02 show a recently-onboarded legitimate admin making a scoped change with a ticket.
Unfamiliar admin, benign-looking change, no ticket located.

DocumentationChecklist.Item: Attach outputs of INV-01-PANCFG-CHANGES, INV-02-PANCFG-LOGIN to the case.

FalsePositive.Definition: A legitimate (possibly new) administrator acting under change control.

SOCAction.Item: Verify the admin and change ticket; close as false_positive; baseline the admin so new_terms learns them.

TruePositive.Definition: An unauthorised or compromised admin modifying the firewall.

Indicators.Item: Sensitive object changes with no ticket.

SOCAction.Item: Review and revert the changes; disable the admin if compromised; open IR.
Check for exposure created by the change.

Misconfiguration.Definition: Automation using an unexpected admin identity due to misconfiguration.

SOCAction.Item: Baseline the automation admin; fix scope if needed; document.

Phase.name: Immediate Actions (0-30 minutes)
Phase.Action: Review the changes; revert if unauthorised.

Phase.name: Containment and Eradication (hours)
Phase.Action: Audit the config diff; check for exposure; reset the admin if compromised.

Phase.name: Recovery and Hardening (days)
Phase.Action: Enforce change control + PAM for firewall admins; alert on sensitive-object changes.

QualityChecks.Check: new_terms keys on the admin - legitimate new admins fire once then learn. panw.panos.admin verified present.
PB-PAN-004 covers the sensitive-object subset with a content filter.

TruePositiveClosure.Item: Unauthorised change reverted; exposure closed; admin session investigated.
